description: The organic Google results for a keyword: rank, url, domain and title, with the time they were observed. $0.002 when collected earlier, $0.005 fetched live.

language.description: Two-letter language code; Chinese is "zh-TW" or "zh-CN". Default "en".

source.description: "index" = results collected earlier, "live" = fetched now, "any" (default) = collected first, live if none.

name: google_results
title: Google results for a keyword
